_comment: Template for the reply-suggestions settings file. Copy it to config/reply-suggestions.settings.json (git-ignored) for development, or to ~/.config/claudecodeui/reply-suggestions.settings.json for an installed deployment, then name it with REPLY_SUGGESTIONS_SETTINGS_PATH when it is not in the default location. Unknown keys (including every `_` key here) are ignored. The file is re-read whenever its modification time changes, so an edit reaches the next request without a restart. No secret is ever written into this file: `apiKeyFile` names where the key lives.
_version: A non-empty string logged beside every extraction, so an edit is visible in the log.
_enabled: The master switch. Default false because the assistant message tail is sent to an external service. A true value with a missing baseUrl, model or key reads as disabled and reports which item is missing.
_baseUrl: The gateway root, e.g. "http://<gateway>". A value already ending in /v1 is not given a second /v1; a trailing slash is tolerated.
_model: The model name sent to the gateway.
_authScheme: How the key travels: "" (the protocol default: x-api-key for anthropic, bearer for openai), "x-api-key", or "bearer".
_apiKeyFile: Path to the key file (a leading ~ is expanded). The file is a bare key line, or a shell-style NAME=value table with optional export and single/double quotes. Mode 600 is expected; a wider mode is reported as a problem but is not fatal.
_apiKeyVar: When the key file holds several assignments, the variable name to read. Empty means: the only assignment if there is exactly one, otherwise the first non-empty line.
_disableThinking: Send thinking: {"type":"disabled"} to the gateway on both protocols. Recommended: the local gateway's default thinking roughly doubles latency and output tokens without improving the suggestions.
_temperature: Sampling temperature for a first draw (0-2).
_redrawTemperature: Sampling temperature for a redraw (0-2); a higher value produces fewer near-duplicates.
_timeoutMs: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (1-120000). A timed-out call fails with 502.
_maxChips: Maximum number of chips returned in one draw (1-10).
_maxChipChars: Each chip is clipped to this many characters (1-2000).
_maxTailChars: How many trailing characters of the last assistant message are sent upstream (1-100000).
_maxFocusChars: How many characters of the client's selected text are used as focus (0-100000); longer selections are clipped, not rejected.
_maxCallsPerMinute: Sliding one-minute upstream call cap (1-100000). Over the cap answers 429.
_maxCallsPerDay: Sliding 24-hour upstream call cap (1-1000000). Over the cap answers 429.
_expansion: Experimental post-selection expansion: "off" (default) or "vary". With "vary", picking a model chip asks for variants of that reply, and quoting a passage asks for responses to it; both appear as chips under the textarea and replace the body when clicked. With "off" an expand request is refused 400 and the composer behaves as before.
_usageLog: Write the local-only JSONL usage ledger (~/.cloudcli/reply-suggestions-usage.jsonl). Rotation: a file that would exceed 5 MB is renamed to .1 and the older .1 is discarded.
_systemPrompt: Empty means the built-in prompt. A non-empty string replaces it whole.
